basics.name: Timothy Lum
basics.label: AI Engineer | Founder, DDO Tech Solutions
basics.summary: Software engineer who ships production AI-powered SaaS end to end: multi-tenant platforms on Next.js, TypeScript, and Postgres, plus automation systems that connect LLMs to CRM, marketing, and internal workflows.

education.institution: University of Hawaii at Manoa, Honolulu, HI
education.area: Computer Science, Minor in Business (expected Aug 2026)

work.summary: AI systems for pricing review at Hawaii's largest HR/PEO provider.
highlights: Built a deterministic and LLM-enhanced pricing-review system that runs a multi-domain analysis spanning profitability, billing integrity, labor burden, and risk exposure across a client book of thousands of businesses.
Modeled the annualized dollar impact of extending the system book-wide, stating sampling method and capture assumptions explicitly so the estimate could be challenged on its terms.
Partner with non-technical pricing staff to convert undocumented business rules into enforced logic in the pricing database.

work.summary: Software company delivering multi-tenant web platforms for small-business clients.
highlights: Founded and operating the company, owning architecture, implementation, deployment, and client relationships.

work.company: Pacific Asian Center for Entrepreneurship, UH Manoa
work.position: Director, Maker Space & AI Innovation Program
work.summary: Ran daily operations of a university prototyping facility supporting student and faculty ventures.
highlights: Designed and taught an AI engineering curriculum for a cohort of non-technical students.
Trained and supported users across 3D printing, laser cutting, embroidery, sublimation, and heat press, and advised student entrepreneurs on technical feasibility and product development.
Served as Associate, Maker Program from Jul 2024 before taking the director role in Apr 2025.

work.summary: Mobile and web development for consumer-facing products.
highlights: Developed mobile and web application features on the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) for consumer-facing products.
Integrated third-party and internal APIs, and supported launch planning, technical documentation, and roadmap execution.
Managed digitization of a physical card game through manufacturing and playtesting.

work.summary: Cyber Security internship with Adapt Forward for the NIWC.
highlights: Learning about high level cyber security policies to ensure proper data security
Research paper and poster based on Polymorphic Malware and AI in Cyber Security
Co-founded and operated the company, owning planning, operations, promotion, and vendor management for large-scale events over five years.

projects.name: Forpono
highlights: Architected and shipped a multi-tenant platform serving customer sites across *.forpono.com plus a separate admin application, built as a Turborepo/pnpm monorepo on Next.js 15 App Router, Supabase/Postgres, and Vercel.
Implemented host-based tenant resolution in middleware, per-tenant sitemap generation, and a single-source indexing predicate governing both robots metadata and sitemap inclusion.
Built a manifest-driven smoke suite run on every merge that asserts SEO and indexing invariants in both directions and fails on unreachable targets rather than skipping them.

projects.name: workflow-intel
highlights: Built a system that continuously gathers and analyzes how AI tools and workflows are being adopted, turning scattered public signal into a searchable, current picture of the landscape.
Delivered it as a production dashboard that answers questions by meaning rather than keyword, so the useful result surfaces even when the wording differs.

projects.name: PACE Bot
projects.description: Realtime voice and text AI avatar for a university entrepreneurship center
highlights: Built a conversational agent with realtime voice via LiveKit, deployed as separate front-end and agent services on Railway.

projects.name: flyer-bot
highlights: Built an automated pipeline that generates and distributes marketing collateral, integrating LLM generation with scheduled and event-driven triggers.

projects.name: EL3vate
projects.description: Resource platform for a University of Hawaii faculty development program
highlights: Built and shipped a digital home giving participating faculty a single place to find the materials relevant to their own discipline.

Designed it so program staff can update content live during a session and publish in one step, with deploy gates that prove themselves against deliberately broken fixtures on every run and refuse to publish past a failure.

volunteer.summary: Governance and strategic oversight for student-run media organizations including Ka Leo, Hawaii Review, KTUH, Manoa Now, and UH Productions.
highlights: Led budgets, policy, and long-range planning across the board's organizations.
Drove a $2 million proposal to completion, closing a process that had been open for 15 years.
Catch moments through photographs
Assist staff with facilitating students
